run_loop_simulation: run the torax simulation loop with jit compilation and return simulation history, post-processed outputs, and error state
run_loop_jit_simulation: run the torax simulation loop under jax.jit with a bounded while loop and return stacked history
unstack_pytree_history: unstack stacked jit pytree history into a list of per-timestep state and output objects
check_for_errors: check the final simulation state for errors and return the sim error status
get_initial_state: get the initial simulation state and post-processed outputs from the step function
